name: policy-gate
description: An organisation policy gate for Crossplane compositions: a function-wasm ABI v2 guest in TypeScript, componentized with jco, that reads each environment's rules from an EnvironmentConfig

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --external:log --outfile=dist/bundle.js && jco componentize dist/bundle.js --wit wit -n function -d http -d fetch-event -o fn.wasm
